reuse_resolution.gap: Existing lift fixes a matching of equally weighted atoms; existing full weighted-row checker only tests a supplied frame. Neither computes the whole next-digit aggregate-mass symmetry fiber.

methods.hard_boundary: Fixed positive ControlPacket, controls, p, guarded seed and next precision. Not amplitude cancellation, raw-word equivalence, global GL6 discovery, universal multi-layer symbolic closure or native physics. Counts of repairs are not path mass.
